job.job_description:
Role: AI Engineer I
Location: Hyderabad
Shift: US PST Night Shift
Experience: 1 - 6 Years
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary

We are looking for an AI Engineer I to support the development and maintenance of AI-powered solutions and workflow automation initiatives. The role involves working with GenAI tools, prompt engineering, automation platforms, and AI-enabled business workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Build and support AI/GenAI and LLM-based solutions
Work on prompt engineering and data preparation
Develop workflow automation solutions
Research and test emerging AI tools and platforms
Collaborate with engineering and data teams
Support documentation and onboarding activities
Follow responsible AI and data governance practices

Required Skills

Basic exposure to AI/GenAI tools and automation platforms
Knowledge of Python or SQL scripting
Understanding of ChatGPT, Claude, Snowflake Cortex, or Salesforce Einstein
Familiarity with low-code/no-code tools and workflow automation
Good communication and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualification

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Engineering, or related field
Certifications such as Microsoft AI-900, Salesforce AI Associate, or Prompt Engineering are a plus
